name: better-workflows
description: Auto-routed, evidence-driven Codex workflow with deterministic safety gates.

interface.shortDescription: One Auto entrypoint with evidence-driven routing.
interface.longDescription: One public Auto template and skill with bound read-only, code-change, and protected dev-publish policies; root-owned mutation, freshness checks, independent review, and fail-closed side-effect gates.
defaultPrompt: Use $better-workflows:auto to handle this task with a bound policy, current evidence, and the required action gates.

Use $better-workflows:auto to deliver authorized changes through a PR targeting protected dev.
